purpose: Controlled human calibration of terrain camera grammar: contextual reveal versus target-locked terrain-form inspection.

terrain_purpose_model.TERRAIN_CONTEXT: geographic extent, location, relationship or scale is the information
terrain_purpose_model.TERRAIN_FORM: three-dimensional relief, shape, walls or depth is the information
terrain_purpose_model.status: experiment-only; not wired into production grammar selection

oblique_reveal.reason: No existing at-location primitive is both oblique and target-locked except the orbit family. reveal/zoom_out are top-down; fly_low is oblique but deliberately points past its target.

canaries.subject: Grand Canyon
canaries.prompt: Show the terrain of Grand Canyon.
canaries.feasibility_note: The subject fits the existing target-locked orbit grammar at its natural framing scale.

decision.why: region framing is within its useful range a selective move is earned here (STARTING_CONTEXT, importance NORMAL)

technical.terminal_settle: covered by camera-quality and terminal-settle authoritative regressions
